caseName: Clark-Cowlitz Joint Operating Agency v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
caseNameFull: Clark-Cowlitz Joint Operating Agency v. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
judges: Blackmun, Consideration, Grant, Motion, Stevens, Took

opinions.text:
Motion for leave to dispense with printing portions of the appendix to the petition for writ of certiorari denied.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, and Justice O’Connor would grant the motion. Justice Scalia took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
